notes: Lowest cost BTM in region: large gas volumes, low gathering fees. Sites near Crane and Winkler counties. Modular power containers welcome (client-supplied). Willing to sign 5-10 year gas supply agreement with price floor/ceiling.

name: Basin Electric – West ERCOT Excess Substation

notes: Existing 345kV substation near Sweetwater TX. Willing to lease land + substation access. Grid-tied: subject to ERCOT queue but fast-track for existing interconnect upgrades. Best for large hyperscaler seeking ERCOT grid access with infrastructure head start.

name: Chord Energy – Bakken Stranded Gas (ND)
keyPain: Strict NDIC flaring regulations with production shut-in threats; associated gas volumes exceed pipeline takeaway capacity; seeking captive generation partner to monetize stranded gas and avoid shut-ins.

notes: 100% renewable (geothermal + hydro). Existing heavy-industrial infrastructure. EU regulatory framework — ESG compliance for hyperscalers. Cold climate: free cooling year-round. name: South Texas Curtailment Zone – Wind Curtailment PPA
keyPain: Frequent wind curtailment in south Texas; generators paid to curtail; seeking industrial load to absorb curtailment and improve project economics.

notes: Flexible pricing: curtailable rate 2-3¢, firm rate 5-6¢. Ideal for Bitcoin mining or AI training workloads that tolerate interruption. 20 miles from LNG terminal (gas backup option). Risk: transmission congestion during high demand. Contact wind project developers directly via ERCOT interconnection queue data.
